backend_endpoints: GET /sellers/:id/analytics (revenue, views, likes, saves, itemsSold, reviews, trust)
frontend_screens: SellerAnalyticsScreen — hero metric, KPI grid, daily bar chart, funnel, top listings, needs attention
CreatorAnalyticsDashboardScreen — separate creator-focused analytics with Skia charts

gaps.title: SellerAnalyticsScreen uses hand-rolled chart instead of Skia BarChart
gaps.evidence: SellerAnalyticsScreen.tsx lines 854-948: DailyViewsChart is a View-based bar chart with no touch interaction, no tooltip, no crosshair, no accessibility summary. The codebase already has a Skia-rendered BarChart component with full state coverage.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Shopify, Stripe, eBay all use interactive charts with tooltips. Research shows touch interaction (tap/scrub for tooltips) is the mobile standard.
gaps.impact: Chart looks primitive vs competitor dashboards. No touch-to-inspect. Inconsistent with CreatorAnalyticsDashboard which uses Skia charts.
gaps.fix: Replace DailyViewsChart with the existing BarChart component from components/charts/

gaps.title: No multi-metric trend chart (views/likes/saves on one chart)
gaps.evidence: Only a single-metric bar chart for views exists. No line chart showing trends across multiple metrics over time.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Shopify supports up to 4 metrics on one line chart. Stripe pairs sparklines with KPIs. eBay shows traffic metrics on line charts.
gaps.impact: Sellers cannot see correlation between views, likes, and saves over time. Limits insight depth.
gaps.fix: Add a LineChart section showing views/likes/saves as multi-series from daily data

gaps.title: No traffic sources breakdown
gaps.evidence: No endpoint or UI for where views come from (search, feed, profile, direct, share).
gaps.competitor_evidence: Etsy: traffic sources (Etsy search, Etsy app, SEO, Direct, Social, Ads). eBay: traffic source breakdown with CTR. This is table-stakes for seller analytics.
gaps.impact: Sellers cannot optimize discovery channels. Major competitive gap vs Etsy/eBay.
gaps.fix: Backend: aggregate interactions.metadata.surface. Frontend: traffic sources section with bar breakdown.

gaps.title: No category performance breakdown
gaps.evidence: No endpoint or UI showing which categories perform best for the seller.
gaps.competitor_evidence: eBay Seller Hub: listing activity by category. Shopify: sales by product type. Third-party Vinted tools: sell-through by category.
gaps.impact: Sellers cannot identify which categories to invest in. Misses inventory strategy insight.
gaps.fix: Backend: aggregate engagement by listing.category. Frontend: category performance rows.

gaps.title: No potential revenue metric
gaps.evidence: No metric showing the total value of active listings (inventory valuation).
gaps.competitor_evidence: Depop: 'Potential revenue' gives live valuation of current listings. Unique differentiator for resale marketplaces.
gaps.impact: Sellers miss inventory value insight. Depop competitive advantage not matched.
gaps.fix: Backend: SUM(price) WHERE status='active'. Frontend: show in hero or KPI grid.

gaps.title: No last-refreshed timestamp or data freshness indicator
gaps.evidence: No indication of when data was last updated.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Shopify: real-time data indicators + 'last refreshed' timestamps. Stripe: open/closed period colors. Etsy: 24-48h lag messaging.
gaps.impact: Sellers don't know if they're looking at stale data. Trust gap.
gaps.fix: Backend: include generatedAt timestamp. Frontend: show 'Updated Xh ago' near header.

gaps.title: No sparklines in KPI cards
gaps.evidence: KPI cards show value + delta only. No mini trend visualization.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Stripe: SparkLineChart paired with KPIs. Shopify: metric cards with trend lines. Research: 'sparklines are best for direction and velocity in metric cards'.
gaps.impact: KPI cards feel flat. Missing at-a-glance trend context.
gaps.fix: Add 7-day sparkline to each KPI card from daily data.

gaps.title: Export is JSON-only, no CSV
gaps.evidence: handleExport writes a JSON file and shares it. No CSV format.
gaps.competitor_evidence: eBay: CSV/XLSX reports + scheduled reports. Shopify: CSV export on every report. Stripe: CSV for Balance, Payouts, Fees. Etsy: CSV download. Depop: CSV sales download. CSV is the universal standard.
gaps.impact: Sellers cannot import into spreadsheets or accounting tools. Major workflow gap.
gaps.fix: Backend: add CSV export endpoint. Frontend: offer CSV alongside JSON in export menu.

gaps.title: No buyer stats (unique buyers, repeat buyers, buyer conversion)
gaps.evidence: No metrics about buyer behavior — unique buyers, repeat purchase rate.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Whatnot: Buyer Count, Buyer Referrals, Buyer Shares. Shopify: returning customer rate. eBay: buyer insights.
gaps.impact: Sellers can't assess customer loyalty or acquisition vs retention.
gaps.fix: Backend: aggregate unique buyers + repeat buyers from orders. Frontend: add to KPI grid.

gaps.title: No chart accessibility summary for screen readers
gaps.evidence: DailyViewsChart has no accessibilityLabel or accessibilitySummary. The Skia BarChart component has accessibilitySummary prop but it's not used here.
gaps.competitor_evidence: Research: 'Provide explicit accessibilityLabel summarizing the chart'. WCAG 1.1.1 requires text alternatives for visual data.
gaps.impact: Screen reader users get no chart information. Accessibility gap.
gaps.fix: Add accessibilitySummary to all chart components.
